notes.title: Echo Ray feat. Konrad Baran live concert
notes.content:
If you like the Venineth soundtrack and want more, check out the concert broadcast on Polish Radio Rzeszow.

Echo Ray, the creator of the Venineth soundtrack, performs with Konrad Baran playing the vibraphone. You will hear themes known from the game in a different, more "analog" arrangement, and also new compositions.

[previewyoutube=zlwC2bBhrg0;full][/previewyoutube]

About the event:

Echo Ray feat Konrad Baran is an eclectic meeting of two musical worlds, ambient and experimental electronics and a vibraphone with jazz roots.
Their concerts are a territory of exploring the nooks and crannies of sound and improvised forms, and the whole is based on Echo Ray's compositions.
The spectrum of sounds will include field recordings made in the wild corners of Polish nature, which refer to nature as an inspiration, as well as sound sources, synthesizers, effects and samples will combine the aspect of space and technology, and finally acoustic instruments that express human need extracting sounds and organizing them into structures called music.

EchoRay is a project of the composer, music producer, multi-instrumentalist and sound designer Artur Zedanja. Echo Ray moves mainly in the field of electronic music, especially in the areas of ambient and experimental music. It uses a wide spectrum of analog and digital sound synthesis, making use of processed field recordings, acoustic and electro-acoustic instruments.
In 2020, the debut double album "Behind The Mirrors Of Infinity" was released, which is also the soundtrack of the game "Venineth".

Konrad Baran - He graduated from Jazz and Stage Music at the Academy of Music. Feliks Nowowiejski in Bydgoszcz. In playing the vibraphone, he uses a unique six-stick technique, which he had the opportunity to perfect during his studies under the watchful eye of Karol Szymanowski, one of the leading Polish jazz vibraphonists, the author of the six-stick technique. In his compositions, Konrad Baran refers to widely understood improvised music and to the works of Scandinavian musicians, such as Jakob Bro, Esbjörn Svensson or Søren Dahl Jeppesen. He had the opportunity to perform at concerts organized as part of the Echo Sonda in Rzeszów, the Bydgoszcz Jazz Academy and at festivals such as Drums Fuzje and Krakow's Synestezje.

The Venineth soundtrack is currently 30% off during the summer sale. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1290840/Venineth_Soundtrack

Other news:

Venineth has been updated to v1.30626, Full changelog including all previous fixes which have been introduced since the previous changelog:

Live long and prosper
Venineth Team

notes.title: Venineth v1.20516 - First person mode, minor improvements and fixes
notes.content:
As always thank you for all reviews and comments, and we ask for more.

Today is a month since the release of Venineth. On this occasion, we have prepared this update. The main feature is the first [strike]person[/strike] ball mode, with and without a crosshair.
In addition, for players for whom disappearing platforms are too difficult, we have prepared a small cheat. More in the description under the spoiler.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33950273/1fad0f0e251f12dd7070c62b921b23d346b808ff.gif

Full changelog:

FPP mode:

 key C or button X on pad - change camera to TPP, FPP with crosshair, FPP without crosshair,
 added fullscreen reset effect in the FPP mode,
 added fullscreen power ball effect in the FPP mode,
 updated graphics in the controls menu,


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33950273/66544181f48edbc68221694c40982842a8e8f7cd.jpg

Improvements:

 added an icon when taking a screenshot on gamepad (LB),
 added an icon showing the number of secrets collected at the current level at the bottom of the pause menu,
 added an easy mode cheat for disappearing platforms - [spoiler] ctrl+alt+P -all platforms are visible from the beginning and do not disappear  [/spoiler],


Fixes:

 fixed rare bug with breakable ice portal on the third level,
 small fixes and improvements.


Venineth Team

notes.title: Venineth v1.20427 - Ultra wide support, FOV adjustment and fixes
notes.content:
Thank you for all reviews and comments, and we ask for more.

We strive to update all fixes you report on a regular basis. This is a summary of all changes that have appeared in the last week.

Options:

 added ultra wide support - 2560 x 1080 and 3440 x 1440, no more black stripes on the sides,
 added FOV adjustment from 70 to 110,
 added 4K support - 3840 x 2160 and 4096 x 2160,
 added checkbox for sharpening effect.
 changed video settings icons for more readable,


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33950273/168305dfb7f52dff7ed7b57890ca2a7c07b1137a.jpg

Controls:

 added altrenative jump button for gamepad - RB,
 fixed graphics in controls menu,


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33950273/16a4fcc5886172aed92557e51f039f542aae3dbb.jpg

Fixes:

 fixed possible softlock on fourth level (first puzzle with lasers),
 fixed checkpoints logic bug on third level (second puzzle with fireball and glass portals),
 fixed rare blocker on fourth level (magnetic ceiling next to the start),
 fixed rare blocker on fourth level (laser and red light on big pylon),
 small fixes and improvements.


Venineth Team
and
Monad Rock Team

notes.title: Open Beta update v0.0818 changelog & current state of the project.
notes.content:
Thanks for all criticism, ideas and bugs reporting, we receive from you in the comments and e-mails.

Download beta:
itch
gamejolt

Update v0.0818 changelog:

optimization:
        - SSR optimization - performance improvement (especially in the last level),

bugfixing:
        - invisible walls placement corrections,  
        - graphics glitches corrections,
        - fixes of several places where the player could get stuck, 

other:
        - minor level design tweaks,
        - Guide Probe now flies into the Capsule,
        - more checkpoints in difficult places,
        - reduction of film grain effect intensity,
 
    No changes in UI /options at the moment, but we are working on it. For now we're focusing on the rest of the game.

Current state of the project:

We're close to finish all levels in the beta state,  more than 20 levels, that means 5-10 hours of gameplay in total. Huge amount of work, too huge for just  two devs... but we can do it!​ Thank you for your patience!

 Reworked menu icons - improving readability:
